hints.title: Grid Obstacle Routing Obstacle
hints.text: Moving strictly down or right through a grid becomes blocked when obstacle cells have value 1. How can propagating reachable path counts across open cells while zeroing out blocked coordinates compute the valid paths to the destination?

hints.title: Zero-Out Obstacle Invariant
hints.text: Any cell marked as an obstacle contributes zero paths. For any open cell, the number of paths is the sum of paths from the cell directly above and the cell directly to the left.

hints.title: 1D Rolling Row Transition Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a 1D array of width n to 0, setting the first cell to 1 if the starting corner is clear. Traverse row by row: for each column, if the cell is an obstacle set its entry to 0, otherwise if column is greater than 0 add the left cell entry to the current entry. Return the last element.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through each cell once with 1D array compression.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: DFS without tabulation branches exponentially taking O(2^(M+N)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compressing M x N matrix to 1D row takes O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Zeroing out obstacle cells in place or via rolling 1D array.
